title: A multi-agent benchmark harness runs every scenario on a sandbox and proves itself by a free replay
goal: benchmarks.py multi builds a sandbox whose agents share one bare origin and a coord store shared or per agent, and leaves the real origin and kb untouched; the frozen scenario inputs and knobs give each run a plan and a cost estimate with no model call; multi run starts the agents of a scenario at once or one at a time, acts as their operator and records each agent's input, output, cache read and cache write, wall time and cost; a replay of every scenario runs with no model call; multi record and the report write the per-scenario tables and the deltas against the baseline
